task_definition.task_description: Please check the current weather in Tokyo, convert 22°C to Fahrenheit, and see if there are any weather alerts; then archive that Tokyo weather advisory by email with high priority. After that, book a deluxe room at Hilton Tokyo for Alex Johnson from 2026-01-16 to 2026-01-18, get the stay sheet and email it with high priority, then book flight CA1234 for Alex Johnson in economy, cancel that flight as a refundable backup plan, and finally save a short travel workflow summary note about the cancellation.
